title: Technology product and reliability decisions
discussion_question: What should a leadership team do when a fast-growing software product is shipping quickly but accumulating operational fragility?
supplementary_materials: Make the tradeoffs concrete. Address release cadence, observability, rollback design, staffing limits, dependency risk, and what evidence would change your recommendation.
output_contract: Respond in three short sections named diagnosis, recommendation, and next signals to watch.
assumptions_and_constraints: Assume the team has limited time, incomplete evidence, and cannot freeze the business indefinitely.
